samples: This is a small authorization library that models permissions (written like "posts:read") and roles (named sets of permissions). It can combine the permissions of several roles, list which required permissions are missing, check whether the roles together cover everything required, and find the permissions two roles share. Its demo `main` checks a sample viewer and editor against a publishing requirement, so it prints the missing permission ("posts:publish") and then the permissions both roles share ("posts:read").

This module treats permissions as validated "resource:action" names and roles as named sets of them. It offers helpers to combine what several roles grant, list which required permissions are still missing, check whether all requirements are met, and find what two roles have in common. Its sample program checks a viewer and an editor against a three-step publishing requirement, so it reports that the publish permission is missing and that the two roles share only read access.

This module models roles as named sets of permissions written as resource and action (like orders and read), and offers helpers to pool the permissions of several roles, list which required permissions are missing, check whether all are covered, and find what two roles share. It is pure set logic with no file, network, or other side effects; only the demo `main` prints to the console. The demo combines a viewer and an editor against a publishing requirement, so it reports that the publish permission is missing and that the two roles share only read access.

This module checks role-based access: it models permissions as validated "resource:action" names, groups them into roles, and offers functions to pool what several roles grant, list which required permissions are still missing, test whether everything required is covered, and find the permissions two roles share. Its demo `main` builds a viewer and an editor role, checks them together against a three-permission publishing requirement, and prints either an approval or the missing permissions, followed by the permissions the two roles share. With the sample data, the combined roles lack the publish permission, so it reports that one as missing and shows that only the read permission is shared. The functions are pure set operations and only the demo needs console output, so the library part looks safe to reuse for simple "do these roles cover this action" checks.

This module models permissions as validated "resource:action" names grouped into roles. It offers functions to combine what several roles grant, list which required permissions are missing, check whether all are covered, and find what two roles share. Its demo `main` checks a sample viewer and editor against a publishing requirement: the roles lack the publish permission, so it prints that permission as missing, then prints the permissions the two roles share (here, read access).
